mapper.sql: SELECT receive_id, receive_no, order_id, order_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, warehouse_id, status, receive_date, total_qty, qualified_qty, unqualified_qty, inspector_id, inspector_name, inbound_order_id, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_receive
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pms_receive ( receive_no, order_id, order_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, warehouse_id, status, receive_date, total_qty, qualified_qty, unqualified_qty, inspector_id, inspector_name, inbound_order_id, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{receiveNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{warehouseId}, #{status}, #{receiveDate}, #{totalQty}, #{qualifiedQty}, #{unqualifiedQty}, #{inspectorId}, #{inspectorName}, #{inboundOrderId}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{auditOpinion}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_receive SET del_flag = '2' WHERE receive_id IN #{receiveId}
mapper.select: SELECT detail_id, receive_id, order_detail_id, material_id, material_code, material_name, spec_model, unit, receive_qty, qualified_qty, unqualified_qty, unit_price, amount, batch_no, production_date, expiry_date, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_receive_detail WHERE receive_id = #{receiveId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY detail_id ASC
mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_receive_detail SET del_flag = '2' WHERE receive_id = #{receiveId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM pms_receive WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status != '4' AND order_id IS NOT NULL
